page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head at the top and the page number at the top right. Small "c." marks stand in the right margin beside two lines. A gathering signature sits at the bottom left and a catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.head: 27. VIGILIVS Romanus.
main_text.p: c.Vigilius Romanus, iam dicti Syluerij accusator ajlutus[?], & fraude pontificatum ambiens, à præ-fatis mulieribus in eius est suffictus[?] locum. Sic duo simul Romæ tunc pontifices erant: alter à Gothis, alter à Græcis, seu potius à mulierculis admissi: & male, at non indigne, ab illis tractabantur. Vterq; enim suæ temeritatis meritas luit pœnas. Nā hic dolo, ille ui, Pontificatum est adeptus: ambo tamen sunt à Papicolis, sanctus martyribus adnumerati. Vigilium Theodora in ius uocauit, quòd promissis non staret. Et Constantinopolim adductum, contumeliisq; ac uerberibus affectum, fune[?] in eius collum iniecto, per urbis plateas illum trahi fecit, & tum demum in exilium pelli. Hic proprias le-ctiones diebus festis aptauit, Romanam ecclesiam aliarum matrem haberi uoluit: candelarum festum instituit, & ut Missa celebretur uersus Orientem. In Sicilia tandem anno Domini 554. mortem & ipse confessor obiit. Horum temporibus Maurus in Gallijs monasticam hypocrisin docuit.
main_text.head: 28. PELAGIVS Romanus.
main_text.p: Pelagius Romanus, dum Totila tyrannus, Dei flagellum dictus, Italiam omnem inuaderet, magno Gothorum, quorum rex erat, applausu, ut author est Procopius, pontificij culmen suscepit.

page.notes: The "c." marks in the right margin are reproduced as printed beside the lines "promissis non staret" and "Maurus in" and are read as marginal section marks. Doubtful readings: "ajlutus" (possibly "absolutus" or similar), "suffictus" (the printed form reads like "suffectus", with a hyphen run across the line), and "fune" (read as "fune" but the scan could show "sune"). Underlined text ("candelarum festum instituit, & ut Missa celebretur uersus Orientem.") is printed with a rule under it; not marked in the transcription.
